Carmen: Quick heads-up — I ran a focused benchmark comparing Llama-2-13B, Mistral-7B, and Qwen-7B across H100 / A100 / MI300 in us-west and eu-central. Tests cover 8k and 32k contexts, rope vs GQA kernel sets, and q4_0/q8/int8 quant configs. Results uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/1827345123 (private)

Raj: Nice. TL;DR numbers? p50/p95 latency and tokens/s per GPU/region for the 8k baseline would be most useful.

Carmen: TL;DR (8k, unbatched single-stream, 1xtoken sampling):
- H100 (us-west): Llama-13B p50 85ms p95 150ms, throughput ~75 tok/s; Mistral-7B p50 60ms p95 120ms, ~95 tok/s; Qwen-7B p50 70ms p95 140ms, ~85 tok/s.
- A100 (eu-central): Llama-13B p50 95ms p95 180ms; Mistral-7B p50 70ms p95 145ms; Qwen-7B p50 95ms p95 220ms (we saw kernel fallback).
- MI300 (us-west): Mistral-7B fastest single-stream but Qwen had a 10-15% latency hit on GQA kernel due to fallthrough to reference kernel.

Marco: Can you paste the exact commands used? Also which runtime flags toggled kernel fallthroughs?

Carmen: Sure — here's the bench command I used:

run_bench --model $MODEL --arch $ARCH --kernel {rope,rope-gqa,gqa} --quant {q4_0,q8,int8} \
  --seq_len 8192 --batch 1 --sampling topk=40 --gpu $GPU --region $REGION --trace kernels

Fallthrough flag was `--kernels.allow_fallback=true` (enabled for safety in early runs).

Alyssa: Re: the Qwen/A100 fallback — what triggered it? memory? op mismatch? Any kernel logs?

Carmen: Logs show kernel selector attempted `rope-gqa-v2` for Qwen but failed a shape assertion on KV stride; it logged `FALLBACK: kernel check failed: stride%16 !=0` then ran `ref-rope`. Attached snippet from trace: `kernel_select: rope-gqa-v2 -> assert stride%16 == 0 (failed)`. I think tokenizer or packing changed layout for that model build.

infra-bot: Deploy note: repro VM image used `runtime:2026-02-18` + patched kernels from `kernels/rope-gqa/exp-7`.

Raj: Important — if fallback is triggered often that kills throughput. Can we reproduce with a minimal input? Try seq=4096 and check stride.

Carmen: Repro steps minimal:

python reproduce.py --model qwen-7b --kernel rope-gqa-v2 --seq 4096 --gpu a100
# output: kernel_select: stride 308 != 0 mod 16 -> fallback

Marco: For quantization regressions: any evals on quality metrics? rouge/qa or logprobs?

Carmen: Yes — quick eval on our promptset (1000 prompts): q4_0 on Mistral lost ~0.6% exact match on code tasks, int8 on Qwen lost ~1.8% on LM perplexity. Full eval CSV in the upload.

Alyssa: Any regional diffs besides the kernel fallback on A100 eu-central? Did we see throughput variance due to network or runtime versioning?

Carmen: eu-central runs used runtime:2026-02-10 vs us-west runtime:2026-02-18 — slight perf delta (~3-4%) due to updated fused attention kernels in the later runtime. We should standardize runtime when comparing.

Raj: Action items:
- Carmen: open a kernel tracker issue for rope-gqa stride assert on Qwen (assign to eng-ml + eng-runtime). Include repro and trace. (priority P1)
- Marco: run 4x parallel streams (batching simulation) on H100/A100/MI300 to get throughput curves for capacity sizing.
- Alyssa: surface q4_0/int8 eval CSV to model-quality dashboard and flag regressions >1%.

Carmen: I'll create the issue and attach the trace + small repro script. Also I'll run Marco's parallel stream experiment and post numbers tomorrow.

infra-bot: Kernel issue created: #K-4127 "rope-gqa stride assertion -> fallback for qwen-7b on A100" (link: https://redwood.internal/issue/K-4127)

Raj: Perfect. If kernel fix won't land quickly, consider a runtime policy to prefer `rope-legacy` for qwen builds in eu-central until fix deploys.

Carmen: Agreed. I can push a canary that pins kernel set per model/region: `model_policy/qwen-7b/eu-central -> prefer: rope-legacy`.

Alyssa: Thanks — good investigative work. Small ask: add the 32k long-context numbers to the upload when you run the batching throughput tests.

Carmen: Will do. Posting follow-up when throughput sweeps complete. :rocket:
